registration.obligation: The caller must register and pump on the same thread and keep callback userdata alive until completion/cancellation. AllowSpontaneous is not permitted by these declarations.

wgpuAdapterRequestDevice.descriptor.deviceLostCallbackInfo.callba: Deferred only when mode is WaitAnyOnly or AllowProcessEvents; descriptor pointer traversal is not checked by Silk.
wgpuAdapterRequestDevice.descriptor.uncapturedErrorCallbackInfo.c: Thread callback: may be invoked at any time from any thread; descriptor pointer traversal is not checked by Silk.

wgpuInstanceWaitAny.reason: Invokes completed callbacks for the supplied futures.

wgpuInstanceRelease.reason: Releasing the final external instance reference cancels retained callbacks, including outstanding asynchronous operations.

wgpuDeviceDestroy.reason: Conservative cancellation boundary: destroys the device and completes its lost event. Nonspontaneous callbacks still follow their configured pump policy.

wgpuDeviceRelease.reason: Releasing the last device reference calls DeviceDestroy; retain the conservative cancellation-boundary marker.

wgpuBufferUnmap.reason: Cancels pending mapping; conservatively treated as a cancellation boundary even though nonspontaneous callbacks remain pump-driven.

wgpuBufferDestroy.reason: Unmaps the buffer and cancels pending mapping; conservatively treated as a cancellation boundary.
